title: Croatian Tamarind Bake
description: A unique crumbly Croatian dish featuring tamarind, perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is a Jain-friendly recipe, making it suitable for those following a lacto-vegetarian diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, oats, brown sugar, and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the tamarind paste, vegetable oil, salt, and lemon juice.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and shape into a ball.
Broil the tamarind ball for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and bake for 20 minutes, or until crumbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
